title: Expected Cartridge Rate for Liability Notices — Insulin Pump Program Prescription Review
content:
For a cartridge or reservoir liability notice on an Insulin Pump Program, the expected rate follows the item's written orders, in three cases:

- where a written order for the item is dated in the three months before today, the standard expected rate is replaced with the newest written order's quantity per 30 days;
- where the newest written order is older than that and the program has a previous refill of the item, it is replaced with the lesser of that order's quantity and the previous refill's units times 30 divided by its supply days, rounded up;
- otherwise the standard expected rate stands.

A record counts as in a number of months before today when its date is later than the same day of the month that many months before today, so a record dated exactly that many months before today is outside the window. The previous refill is the program's latest refill shipment of the item.

| Hypothetical records | Expected rate |
|---|---|
| Order dated last month, 16 per 30 days | replaced with 16 |
| Newest order 5 months old, 16 per 30 days; previous refill 39 units over 90 days | 39 times 30 divided by 90 is 13; replaced with the lesser of 16 and 13, which is 13 |
| Newest order 5 months old, 12 per 30 days; previous refill 40 units over 90 days | 13.33 rounded up is 14; replaced with the lesser of 12 and 14, which is 12 |
